sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Compiler settings for the API server
sections.what: Inherits shared settings, then turns on faster rebuilding, writes output to dist, uses the repository root as the source root, limits built-in type names to Node, checks everything under src, and lists two shared projects to build first.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Changing the source root setting moves where compiled files appear.

summary: Sets the TypeScript compiler options for the API server, including which code is checked and where compiled output goes.
purpose: Tells the compiler which files to check, where to write compiled output, and which shared projects to build first.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The referenced folders suggest the server shares database and API code with other parts of the repository.
how: 1. Load the shared base settings from the root file. 2. Turn on incremental builds and store the build cache in a named file. 3. Write compiled output to dist. 4. Use the repository root as the source root. 5. Include only Node type definitions. 6. Check all code under src. 7. Build two referenced shared projects first.
inputs: Source files under src, the root base settings file, and two referenced projects in lib.
outputs: Compiled files in dist, and a build cache file.
risks: Changing the source root moves where compiled files appear. Including only Node types means browser-only type names will not compile here.
debug: If the build fails with missing modules, check that the two referenced folders exist and build. If output appears in the wrong place, check the source root and output folder settings. If builds seem stale, remove the build cache file and rebuild.
